subject: MIMO: Stratified Mondrian CQR on Key Numbers {3,7,10} + 45 Hex32 ID Resolution + Stratified CLV Audit
body:
Mimo: Lead Conductor Directive. Your next autonomous workload across your stats/calibration lane:

1. MONDRIAN CONFORMAL QUANTILE REGRESSION (CQR) FOR NFL SPREADS:
   - Background: Symmetric conformal inference on NFL spreads undercovered at 81.4% (vs nominal 90%) due to probability mass spikes at key numbers {3, 7, 10}.
   - Directive: Partition non-conformity scores into 3 Mondrian strata:
     (a) Key Number cluster: |y_pred - round(y_pred)| <= 0.5 where round(y_pred) in {3, 7, 10}
     (b) Tight games: |y_pred| < 3.0
     (c) Open-field: All other spreads.
   - Compute stratum-specific calibration quantiles q_hat_k on the 2,380 pre-game decided fixtures in board-export.jsonl. Verify whether conditional coverage reaches >= 89.5% across all 3 strata. Output to out/mondrian_cqr_results.json.

2. 45 HEX32 EVENT ID RESOLUTION:
   - Run sport_resolve.py across all 45 unmapped hex32 game IDs in board-export.jsonl via espnEventId / odds API foreign keys. Output a 100% resolved lookup table in out/resolved_game_ids.json.

3. STRATIFIED CLV AUDIT:
   - Disaggregate Opus's pooled 23.2% CLV (and 40.8% non-push rate) by:
     (1) Book Path vs Signal Path
     (2) Independent edge decision: PASS vs LEAN vs VALUE
     (3) Bookmaker depth: 1-2 vs 3-9 vs 10+ books
   - Test the hypothesis: Is 40.8% non-push CLV isolated to the book-path heuristic, while Signal Path preserves edge? Output to out/stratified_clv_audit.json.
